# ru.pinterest.com

> Russian Pinterest is a visual discovery and curation platform featuring diverse idea boards spanning beauty techniques, crafts, cultural aesthetics, and creative inspiration.

ru.pinterest.com serves Russian-speaking users with curated Pinterest boards covering hair styling, beadwork, cultural imagery, photography inspiration, and DIY projects. The platform emphasizes visual storytelling through collections organized by theme and user interest.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest boards
- Airtouch hair contouring
- Balayage and hair coloring
- Hello Kitty amigurumi
- Beadwork patterns
- Uzbek cultural aesthetics
- Beauty and hair techniques
- Photography inspiration
- Polymer clay crafts
- Fashion illustration
- Drawing tutorials
- Character art and fan art
- Aesthetic inspiration
- DIY projects
- Russian beauty trends

## Hair & Beauty Styling

- [Аиртач С Контурингом](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas/аиртач-с-контурингом/917546335394/): Pinterest board showcasing airtouch hair contouring and balayage techniques

## Crafts & Beadwork

- [Амигуруми Из Бисера Схемы Хеллоу Китти](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas/амигуруми-из-бисера-схемы-хеллоу-китти/953092325418/): Pinterest board with Hello Kitty bead amigurumi patterns and beadwork schemes
- [проект по технологии 7 класс](https://ru.pinterest.com/4382280v/проект-по-технологии-7-класс/): Pinterest board with middle school technology projects and DIY craft ideas

## Cultural & Aesthetic Inspiration

- [Гамгин Расмлар](https://ru.pinterest.com/ideas/гамгин-расмлар/919035492917/): Pinterest idea board for Uzbek cultural images and aesthetic inspiration

## Photography & Portrait Ideas

- [Идеи на тему «Промт для сессии у моря»](https://ru.pinterest.com/aforseeva/промт-для-сессии-у-моря/): Anastasia Forseeva's Pinterest board for beach photoshoot and ocean portrait ideas

## Art & Character Design

- [Идеи на тему «[ poey Perto ]»](https://ru.pinterest.com/dhdhdhej432/poey-perto/): User Chance's Pinterest board with cute doodles, fan art, and character drawings
